editorial_scope: recommendation only; no Master row or stable ID changed
requirements: CG-MASTER: verify source-scene context, stable record identity, duplicate candidates and approve target expression before data patch
CG-ENTEACH: revise expression, examples, gloss and collocations consistently after Master decision
CG-QA: independently evaluate actual revised KU against Master-approved record
Muse: independent review when quota available; never infer PASS from deferment

records.source_example_en: I put away the clutter on my desk before starting work.
records.author_revised_example_en: I put away the scattered items on my desk before starting work.
records.rationale: Clutter is an uncountable collection; clear away clutter is idiomatic. If teaching put away, use concrete plural items.
records.verification: Author must select one lexical target and align expression, gloss and example before QA.

records.source_example_en: This sweater came out of the wash with shrunk sleeves.
records.author_revised_example_en: This sweater shrank in the wash, especially around the sleeves.
records.rationale: Shrunk is widely used as a past participle; as a prenominal modifier shrunken is more idiomatic. Do not imply 'shrunk clothes' is ungrammatical in all dialects.
records.verification: Check source sense and example and whether a variant should be modeled rather than a new KU.

records.author_revised_zh: 在不明显部位测试面料
records.source_example_en: Spot-test a fabric on a hidden seam first.
records.author_revised_example_en: Spot-test the cleaner on a hidden area of the fabric first.
records.alternative: test a cleaner on an inconspicuous area
records.rationale: Object of spot-test is commonly the product; the fabric provides the test surface. Testing fabric itself is possible in other technical contexts.
records.verification: Confirm learning goal (cleaner suitability versus fabric colorfastness) in original scene.

records.source_example_en: The red towel caused color bleed in the wash.
records.author_revised_example_en: The red towel caused color bleeding in the wash.
records.rationale: Color bleed exists as a noun phrase in technical usage; color bleeding is an intuitive process label. No automatic substitution without matching scene context.
records.verification: Check scene-scoped identical/near-equivalent expressions and distinct teaching intents.

records.source_example_en: Prep the ingredients while the oven heats up.
records.author_revised_example_en: Prep the ingredients while the oven heats up.
records.rationale: Definite article is contextual, not a sufficient lexical sense distinction; two records differing solely by it should not create separate teaching targets.
records.verification: Compare both KU IDs, scene, sense, gloss and examples; retain one stable identity or document truly distinct usages.

records.source_example_en: White dishwasher residue was left on some glasses.
records.author_revised_example_en: There was a white residue on some glasses after the dishwasher cycle.
records.rationale: The compound is interpretable but may refer to residue on dishes or in the appliance, requiring different teaching context.
records.verification: Examine full source sentence before selecting referent and canonical expression.

records.source_example_en: The water overflow damaged the cabinet below the sink.
records.author_revised_example_en: The water overflow damaged the cabinet below the sink.
records.rationale: Water overflow is a viable technical nominal expression, but ordinary dialogue may require verbal overflowing water or water is overflowing.
records.verification: Preserve noun/verb part-of-speech distinction; review actual sentence and scene.

records.source_example_en: I need some peace and quiet after work.
records.author_revised_example_en: I need some peace and quiet after work.
records.rationale: Fixed phrase should be retained unchanged. Identical text within same scene is not proof of distinct sense.
records.verification: Compare second KU ID and distinct sense/use; otherwise propose consolidation with stable-ID alias rather than deleting source record.

records.source_example_en: Take a screen break if your eyes feel tired.
records.author_revised_example_en: Take a screen break if your eyes feel tired.
records.rationale: Original phrase is natural; synonymy alone is not a quality defect. Potential duplication is a KU identity governance issue.
records.verification: Locate other KU in scene; compare meaning/example/teaching objective and preserve source and IDs.
